change: Native font backend, playlist/mixer design and read-only viewport navigation
notes: Measured with preview windows and other build/test processes stopped. Audio processing code is unchanged by this UI work.
Four channels; playback restarts every 180 blocks to maintain audible content. The telemetry scenario consumes bounded queues every 12 blocks, approximately 30 Hz.
This microbenchmark excludes GPUI layout, painting, fonts, FFT, scope true peak and device I/O. It is not a UI frame-rate or callback latency measurement.
Criterion reports a lower baseline and telemetry change within its noise threshold against the previous run; no UI performance improvement is inferred.

Physical-device callback p95/p99, xrun endurance and unlocked-desktop input acceptance remain separate gates. Real dark/light window capture and GPUI keyboard/controller navigation smoke are recorded in implementation status.
